'''Tulatharri Junction''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located within the [[Tulatharri Junction system/Legends|Tulatharri Junction system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Republic [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] participated in military actions at Tulatharri Junction and was later decorated for his efforts while fighting there.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulatharri Junction was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tulatharri Junction [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Tulatharri Junction, within grid square K-3.<ref name="EAOC" />
